decisions.reason: As a resin-processing unit in the firm’s core equipment range, it remains worth keeping because the carrying cost is limited and its continued presence after launch suggests enough customer value to justify the option.

The automatic airless spray gun is tightly aligned with established spray-application capabilities and channels, so if it is still marketed by 2022 the revealed fit makes withdrawal relatively unlikely.
A manual airless spray gun is a standard adjacent offering for the firm’s existing customers, and its strong fit with the installed product portfolio makes keeping it the more attractive choice.

This multi-model air-assisted airless spray gun line offers broad coverage across customer segments in a core application area, giving it the highest ongoing option value and the lowest near-term withdrawal risk.
